fact_text: The KSE-100 rose 4,298 points, or 3.2%, in the week ending around 18 July 2025 and closed at a new record high, with banks leading the advance.

fact_text: The reporter and an interviewee judged the rally narrow, concentrated in high-dividend-yield stocks such as banks and fertilisers rather than broad-based across the market.

fact_text: Pakistan Services shares rose 55.4% in the week reported on the show, the largest weekly gain cited.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: JVDC shares rose 18.6% in the week reported on the show.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer posted strong gains in the reported week and is the largest KSE-100 stock, with an index weight of over 9%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Weekly losers reported were the stock ticker SEL (down 9.1%), Kohat Cement (down 7.5%), Bannu Woollen (down 6.8%), National Refinery (down 6.8%) and Kohinoor Spinning Mills (down 6.7%).
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Pakistan posted a current account surplus of $328 million in June 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: The full-year FY25 current account showed a surplus of $2.1 billion, the first annual surplus in 14 years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Exports were $2.6 billion in June 2025, up 7% month on month, while imports were $4.98 billion, down 9% month on month.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: IT exports were $38 million in June 2025, up 4% month on month, and $3.8 billion in FY25, up 18% year on year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Large-scale manufacturing rose 2.3% year on year in May 2025, but the first 11 months of FY25 were still negative at about 1.2%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Remittance growth of 27% in FY25 was the main reason the current account moved into surplus, according to the reporter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: A persistent gap between open-market and interbank dollar rates could push remittances from formal to informal channels, which would weaken the current account.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: The government's FY26 target was a current account deficit of $1.5 to 2 billion; the interviewee said weaker-than-expected remittances could widen it to $2 to 3 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: The GDP growth figure cited for the year was 4.2%, which supported the current account outlook.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: The State Bank kept its policy rate at 11% in June 2025, after cutting by 100 basis points in May and bringing it down from 22%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: The State Bank's June hold was attributed to budget season, the IMF review and high geopolitical noise and oil price swings, which made a cautious stance understandable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: The interviewee expected the State Bank to cut rates by a further 100 to 150 basis points, with room for a cut of about 1 to 1.5 points in Q1 FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: The IMF review was completed and its tranche received, and the government's budget was passed, easing pressure on the State Bank.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: The State Bank was buying dollars actively from the market to build reserves, which the interviewee called a first in Pakistan's history.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Umrah and Hajj travel and summer travel add seasonal demand for dollars, which the interviewee expected to add to exchange-rate pressure.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Loans from China, Saudi Arabia and the UAE were rolled over or refinanced, including a Chinese bank loan repaid in early 2025 and refinanced by June 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: A $500 million Eurobond payment falls due in September 2025, and Pakistan had not yet returned to the international bond market to borrow.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: State Bank reserve building ahead of the September Eurobond payment may explain part of the tightness seen in the foreign exchange market.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Bank stocks rallied on high dividend yields, and the interviewee expected investors to switch from banks that had already rallied to laggards that still offer double-digit yields as rates fall.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Banks are assessed on valuation, yield and future growth; an 8% yield alone is less attractive than the same yield backed by a growth story.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Banks setting dividend policy must be careful: raising payouts too early and then pulling back damages investor trust.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: National Bank of Pakistan earned about Rs 10 a share in Q1 2025, helped by handbook provisioning and with no capital gains booked.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: National Bank of Pakistan traded near Rs 125 a share in July 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: NBP paid no dividend after 2016; its payout averaged about 70% over the five years to 2016 and about 50 to 55% over ten years, per the interviewee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Average analyst estimates for NBP's full-year earnings were cited at about Rs 30 to 32 a share, against a Q1 2025 figure of Rs 10.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: NBP's Q2 2025 earnings may land in the Rs 9 to 10 range, since revaluation surplus across banks has grown and can lift reported earnings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: On an assumed Rs 20 full-year dividend, NBP's yield would be above 14 to 15%, and the interviewee saw room in its leverage and capital adequacy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: If Fauji Fertilizer regains Shariah compliance, it could enter the KMI-30 index with a double-digit weight and become its largest stock, forcing Islamic funds benchmarked to KMI-30 to allocate.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: A 5 to 10% allocation by Islamic funds to Fauji Fertilizer would shift billions of rupees of liquidity into the stock, according to the interviewee's simulation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer was non-compliant mainly because of the non-compliant share of its other income, which is a large part of its earnings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Falling interest rates are shrinking Fauji Fertilizer's interest-linked other income, which could reduce the non-compliant share over time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Fauji Fertilizer's dividend dips every first quarter, which could make it non-compliant for that quarter alone and raise questions for Shariah advisers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: The interviewee's fund had an equity allocation above 90% in July 2025, and it has stayed almost fully invested in equities over the past two years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Mutual fund inflows that returned in 2024 lifted the KSE-100 out of a stalled range and drove it to new highs by the end of 2024, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Liquidity flows can overshadow valuations, earnings and fundamentals, so the interviewee said investors must judge which face of the market is in play.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Institutions, retirement funds and individuals not yet allocated to equities hold sidelined money; if inflows continue, the multiple could re-rate and the index could break out of its range.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: The market expects the acquirer to be the Chirag group as a whole, with its associates, rather than Chirag Cement alone.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: The Chirag group had cash availability of about 9.5 billion, which may fund its share of the acquisition alongside a holding company.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: At an analyst's full-year estimate of about Rs 47 a share, Chirag Cement traded at about six times earnings, below the cement sector's eight to ten times.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: The Chirag group is diversified across packaging and unlisted companies, and the interviewee called it one of Pakistan's steadier groups.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)

fact_text: Rafhan Maize was valued at a market capitalisation of about 80 to 90 billion rupees and traded near 10 to 11 times earnings, against about 22 times for Unilever Pakistan Foods.

source_name: Nukta Business, 'KSE-100 Hits Record High | What’s Driving the PSX Rally? | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-19)
